metrics.name: DeFi capital
metrics.definition: USD value in tracked NEAR DeFi protocols.
metrics.limitation: Valuation changes are not net inflows. Positions can overlap across protocols.

metrics.name: Stablecoin supply
metrics.definition: Tracked circulating stablecoin value on NEAR, in USD.
metrics.limitation: Overlaps DeFi capital. Not a count of holders or payments.

metrics.name: Intents volume
metrics.definition: Provider-reported one-sided swap notional routed through Intents.
metrics.limitation: Not unique customers, NEAR L1 volume, profit, or tokenholder income.

metrics.name: Gross service fees
metrics.definition: Provider-reported gross service fees, before operating costs or token allocation.
metrics.limitation: API total is $145,994.83 below the saved Dune total ($6.53M), a 2.24% unresolved gap. Neither total is tokenholder income.
